user.title: Irabelle Home Learning
user.description: The house teaches itself. Requests your voice assistant could not answer locally come back as sentences the local matcher answers from then on - in milliseconds, with no model call. Next you set up the first agent; add more any time from the integration page.

data_description.language: The language learned sentences are written in (custom_sentences/LANGUAGE/), e.g. en.
data_description.export_path: Optional. Where the export action writes intent_script stubs when configuration.yaml does not already say. Empty: {default_path}

agent.title: Agent
agent.description: An agent is what you pick as the **Conversation agent** of a voice assistant. It hands every sentence to the agent that really answers, returns that answer unchanged, and learns from the turn with two models. Add one agent per combination you want - for example "Jev → DeepSeek" and "ChatGPT → DeepSeek". Everything any agent learns is answered locally for all of them.

data_description.name: How this agent is listed in the voice assistant's conversation agent dropdown.
data_description.delegate_agent: The agent that really answers. Its answer is returned unchanged.
data_description.judge: Answers quick typed judgements on almost every miss: is this worth learning, which intent does it mean, is this answer right. Jev is built for this - fast and a fraction of a cent. Any other model works the same, slower. None learns by binding only.
data_description.ai_task_entity: Writes and reviews the templates behind new answers - rare, larger calls. AI Task entities answer with structured output; conversation agents are asked for JSON.

jev.title: Jev API
jev.description: Where the TypeSafe System One API lives, when it is called directly rather than through the Jev integration.

data_description.jev_endpoint: Leave as it is unless TypeSafe changes it.
data_description.jev_model: jev-latest follows the current release; pin a version to keep thresholds meaningful.
data_description.jev_api_key: Leave empty to use the key already configured for the Jev integration.

error.jev_not_installed: The Jev integration is not installed. Pick another classification model, or Jev API.

abort.already_configured: Irabelle Home Learning is already set up. Add another agent from its integration page instead.

init.title: Irabelle Home Learning
init.description: Settings shared by every agent. The agents themselves - name, answering agent, models - are changed from the integration page (⋮ → Reconfigure).

data_description.language: The language learned sentences are written in (custom_sentences/LANGUAGE/), e.g. en.
data_description.auto_learn: When on, a request the local matcher missed is learned without anyone asking.
data_description.min_occurrences: A phrasing said twice is one that will be said again. 1 learns everything immediately, at the cost of a model call per new request.
data_description.export_path: Optional. Where the export action writes intent_script stubs when configuration.yaml does not already say. Empty: {default_path}

learn.name: Learn phrasing
learn.description: Bind one or more utterances to an intent that already exists, so they are answered locally.

slots.name: Slots
slots.description: Optional slot values for the intent.

response.name: Response
response.description: Optional reply to say after the intent runs.

learn_intent.name: Learn intent
learn_intent.description: Create a new intent from a Jinja template plus the words people say.

template.name: Template
template.description: Jinja that renders the spoken answer.

slots.name: Slots
slots.description: The word lists the wording varies by, e.g. {day: [today, tomorrow]}.

response.name: Response
response.description: Optional reply text, if it differs from the template.

forget.name: Forget phrasing
forget.description: Remove a phrase this integration previously learned.

forget_intent.name: Forget intent
forget_intent.description: Remove an intent this integration learned, with its sentences.

forget_all.name: Forget everything
forget_all.description: Remove every learned intent and every learned sentence file, leaving hand-written sentences untouched.

observations.name: List observations
observations.description: What the house has heard that it could not answer locally, and what it decided to do about it.

state.name: State
state.description: Only show rows in this state: new, learned or ignored.

route.name: Route an utterance
route.description: What the router would decide for one utterance, without learning anything.

answer.name: Answer
answer.description: What the agent answered, if known.

targets.name: Targets
targets.description: Entities the answer touched, if known.

judge.name: Ask the classifier
judge.description: Ask the classification model typed questions directly. With no questions it reports its configuration and spend.

state.name: State
state.description: What the questions are about: text or an object.

questions.name: Questions
questions.description: Questions by id: {type: choice|noul|score, instructions, criteria}.

review.name: Review learned answers
review.description: Check what each learned intent will say. Reports by default; apply lets it fix.

intent.name: Intent
intent.description: Only review this learned intent. Omit to review all of them.

apply.name: Apply
apply.description: Let the reviewer change what it finds wrong.

audit.name: Audit one intent
audit.description: Re-judge the next installed intent in line, changing nothing.

sweep.name: Sweep observations
sweep.description: Mark recorded requests that are about the assistant rather than for the house.

consolidate.name: Consolidate files
consolidate.description: Move every intent's sentences and reply into one file of its own.

duplicates.name: Find duplicates
duplicates.description: Every entity read by more than one learned intent, and whether they are one question.

template.name: Template
template.description: A new template for the merged intent.

reply.name: Reply
reply.description: A new reply for the merged intent.

phrasings.name: Phrasings
phrasings.description: Phrasings bound to built-in intents to reclaim.

combine.name: Combine phrasings
combine.description: Fold the phrasings of an intent into one template per wording. Dry run unless apply is set.

intent.name: Intent
intent.description: Only this learned intent. Omit for all of them.

reconsider.name: Reconsider observations
reconsider.description: Ask the processing model to look again at what it passed over or refused.

utterance.name: Utterance
utterance.description: Only reconsider this phrase. Omit to reconsider everything not learned.

set_response.name: Set response
set_response.description: Change what a learned intent says, without re-learning it.

rename_intent.name: Rename intent
rename_intent.description: Give a learned intent another name, and its file the matching one.

export.name: Export intent_script
export.description: Write intent_script stubs for every learned intent, so they keep answering if the integration is removed.

validate.name: Validate sentence files
validate.description: Quarantine any sentence file that does not parse, then reload conversation.

tools.name: List learner tools
tools.description: Diagnostics: which teaching tools a given platform can see.

fold.name: Fold phrasings into templates
fold.description: Have the processing model write templates such as (press|toggle) [the] D2 keyboard for each group of learned phrasings, proved by the matcher and the classification model. Runs by itself after each learning; this runs it on demand. Dry run unless apply is set.

intent.name: Intent
intent.description: Only this intent's groups. Omit for all of them.

apply.name: Apply
apply.description: Write the folds that pass every check.
